title: An authenticated history cannot be read around, and nothing unvetted signs for it
note: D-2026-92. AP1-AP9: the signature-provider seam -- the reference implementation is an oracle and a test-identity signer, never a production provider by default or by label; a provider is judged on RFC 8032's vectors and on every refusal a conforming Ed25519 makes, a raising verifier included; production needs both a vetted provider and a provisioned registry. EP1-EP9: the history's security profile, enforced in the verified-read primitives every reader reads through -- no authenticator reads nothing of an AUTHENTICATED_REQUIRED history, a refused event ends the read and fails the report, a declaration is genesis-only and known, anchored catch-up is gated like a full read, and a pinned deployment refuses a downgrade. RC1-RC2: the independent reader restates the profile in its own code. AR1: the declaration is a registered action.

mutations.name: AP1_the_reference_passes_for_vetted
mutations.rationale: the pure-Python transcription becomes the production trust provider by default

mutations.name: AP2_the_label_is_believed
mutations.rationale: a provider that says VETTED is taken at its word; behaviour is not checked

mutations.name: AP3_the_malleable_signature_is_not_asked_about
mutations.find:
"the malleable s + Q": (pk, msg,
                                sig[:32] + int.to_bytes(s, 32, "little")),
mutations.rationale: the gate stops asking whether s + Q is refused, and a provider accepting the malleable twin passes

mutations.name: AP4_a_raising_verifier_is_read_as_a_refusal
mutations.rationale: a verifier that throws on malformed input is counted as one that refused it

mutations.name: AP5_the_rfc_signatures_are_not_compared
mutations.find: if ask(f"vector {n} sign", provider.sign, sk, msg) != sig:
mutations.rationale: a provider that signs something other than RFC 8032 says passes

mutations.name: AP6_the_reference_signs_a_production_key
mutations.rationale: a production key is signed by the reference implementation

mutations.name: AP7_the_authenticator_ignores_its_provider
mutations.rationale: the injected provider is never asked; the reference decides regardless

mutations.name: AP8_production_skips_the_vetted_check
mutations.rationale: production authentication accepts any provider, the reference included

mutations.name: AP9_a_second_genesis_is_allowed
mutations.rationale: begin_history no longer checks it is starting a history

mutations.name: EP1_a_required_history_is_read_without_an_authenticator
mutations.rationale: the omission the profile exists for: no authenticator, and every event is read anyway

mutations.name: EP2_a_refused_event_does_not_end_the_read
mutations.find: return [ev for ev in events if ev.seq < first]
mutations.rationale: events after an unauthenticated one are handed to the reader

mutations.name: EP3_authentication_findings_are_not_problems
mutations.rationale: the report says ok over a history that did not authenticate

mutations.name: EP4_a_misplaced_declaration_is_accepted
mutations.rationale: a declaration past genesis switches the profile mid-history

mutations.name: EP5_an_unknown_profile_is_accepted
mutations.rationale: an unknown profile is taken as whatever it says, and reads as not requiring authentication

mutations.name: EP6_the_anchored_read_is_not_gated
mutations.find:
admitted = self._security_gate(
            [ev for ev, _, _ in tail[:verified]], problems, whole=False)
mutations.rationale: a reader catching up from an anchor skips the profile altogether

mutations.name: EP7_a_downgrade_is_accepted
mutations.rationale: a pinned deployment reads a history rewritten without its declaration

mutations.name: EP8_a_declaration_is_written_anywhere
mutations.rationale: an honest writer is allowed to declare a profile past genesis or an unknown one

mutations.name: EP9_genesis_is_not_consulted_after_an_anchor
mutations.rationale: an anchored read takes every history as legacy

mutations.name: RC1_the_independent_reader_does_not_restate_the_profile
mutations.rationale: the second reader relies on the primitive's gate instead of refusing in its own code

mutations.name: RC2_the_independent_reader_accepts_a_misplaced_declaration
mutations.find: if ev.seq != 0 or p.get("profile") not in _PROFILES:
mutations.rationale: the second reader folds past a declaration anywhere but genesis

mutations.name: AR1_the_declaration_is_an_unknown_action
mutations.rationale: the action is dropped from the registry, and every reducer refuses a REQUIRED history outright

mutations.name: AH22_an_empty_history_is_remembered_as_legacy
mutations.find:
if nonempty:
            # Remembered only once the history HAS a genesis to have
mutations.replace:
if True:
            # Remembered only once the history HAS a genesis to have
mutations.rationale: a reader that saw the log before genesis keeps LEGACY and folds a REQUIRED history's anchored tail unauthenticated

mutations.name: AH23_an_empty_anchored_tail_needs_no_authenticator
mutations.rationale: a writer holding an anchor extends a REQUIRED history without ever authenticating its head
